saveError.storage: Saving data in the browser failed. Export the data (JSON) so you don't lose it.
saveError.duplicate: The change was not saved: a parcel with that number already exists in that municipality, maybe another member just added it. Showing the data from the server.
saveError.network: The change was not saved because there is no internet connection. Showing the data from the server; repeat the change when you are back online.
saveError.generic: The change was not saved on the server. Showing the data from the server, so check your last change.
